*Field Visit – Experiential learning beyond the classroom through real-world exploration.
*Special Experience – A unique hands-on learning opportunity designed to enrich children’s curiosity and engagement.
*Show and Tell – An interactive speaking activity where children share and present their ideas, objects, or experiences confidently.
*Evaluation – Ongoing assessment to understand and support each child’s learning progress.
*Parent Interactions – Meaningful communication between parents and educators regarding child development.
*No Uniform Day – A fun and relaxed day encouraging self-expression and comfort.
*School Event – A school-wide celebration, activity, or special program for students.
*Class Event – Classroom-based activities designed for collaborative and joyful learning experiences.
*Parent Connect & Learning Showcase – A platform for parents to witness and discuss children’s learning journey and performances.
*Holiday – School remains closed in observance of festivals, national events, or special occasions.
